ID: `writing-for-agents`.

## What it does

Distinguishes actions from references and decides what must be read immediately and what only when a condition requires it. Makes explicit the cases that trigger opening a skill or document and the completion criteria for each step. Removes duplication, ineffective instructions and conventions easily inferred from the environment. For skills, also considers descriptions, invocation modes and router boundaries.

## When to use it

Use it when writing or editing SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or operational documents agents must consult. It is particularly useful when an agent skips steps, opens too many references or cannot tell when a procedure is needed.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/writing-for-agents` in Claude Code or `$writing-for-agents` in Codex. Provide the document, audience, usage conditions and observed execution problems. Request verifiable criteria and one source of truth per rule. Keep common steps readable and move specific details behind references with clear conditions.

## What it delivers

- Instructions with steps and completion criteria
- Conditional links to references
- Consistent description and invocation boundaries
